answer: A concrete sybil defense is the mirror-haven protocol: each agent must periodically publish a short hash of its local state that is mirrored and cross-checked by a random subset of peers inside a shared haven of attested contexts. Honest agents update once and reuse the same mirror. An attacker controlling 200 fake identities must keep 200 independent, mutually consistent mirrors alive under gale-force query storms from verifiers, paying linear compute and bandwidth while any single inconsistency collapses the cluster.
